title: Consolidation of Business Partners with Automation​ and Federation
description:
The process template SAP_BP_CFA - SAP: Consolidate BP Federation Automated is used to import data using a consolidation process in the core data owner system (Goal C (Consolidation)). The system applies the automation steps Address Validation and Enrichment, and Derivation. After the matching step, if there are open match groups, a match review workflow is triggered to review the potential matches. If the validation step returns errors, a rework workflow is triggered.
If additional confirmations are required from the application data owner, two process templates are relevant: If no matches are found, the template SAP_BP_IAA - SAP: ADO Inbound Approve BP Automated is used (Goal P (Inbound Process Approve)). If matches are found, the process template SAP_BP_IMA - SAP: ADO Inbound Merge BP Automated is used, which takes care of merging the data in the additional data owner system (Goal Y (Inbound Process Merge)). Derivations can also be used in the additional data owner system to enrich the data.

description: The SAP_BP_DCF - SAP: Decentralized Create BP Federation template is used to create data from a different system or an application data owner. In this case, an inbound process on the core data owner is created using the SAP_BP_DCF - SAP: Decentralized Create BP Federation template (Goal F (Decentralized Maintenance, Create)). The inbound process carries out a duplicate check in the core data owner system. If no matches are found, the SAP_BP_IA - SAP: ADO Inbound Approve BP template is used (Goal P (Inbound Process Approve)). If matches are found, the process template SAP_BP_IM - SAP: ADO Inbound Merge BP is used that merges the data in the additional data owner system (Goal Y (Inbound Process Merge)). If the application data owner needs to make further approvals, an inbound process will be created using the SAP_BP_IA - SAP: ADO Inbound Approve BP (Goal P template (Inbound Process Approve)).
